task.description: 帮我接通这个依赖漏洞公告服务，通过指定方式做一次真实查询，确认能取得可识别的公告记录，并保存后续查询需要的本地配置；说明接入步骤和实际阻碍。
task.inputs: 服务、指定入口及本轮允许使用的身份或凭据见 ENVIRONMENT.md。自行选择一个小型公开公告查询，报告实际取得的公告标识、关联包名和来源。无需账号的入口直接使用；需要注册或授权时仅使用本轮提供的资料。必要配置保存在本轮持久目录，秘密只存私有文件；答复给出配置位置、已有账号来源、自助步骤及实际人工或申请要求。
task.expected_output: 一条来自指定服务的真实公告记录，含可识别标识、关联包名及来源；可复用配置位置；真实接入步骤与门槛，或具体阻碍。
task.success: 按指定方式完成必要安装、认证和配置，实际响应含可识别的公告及关联包，答复与响应一致；配置可供新会话复用且不泄露秘密。无需账号不强行注册，已有账号不冒充本轮自助注册。
task.failure: 没有真实公告查询，改用其他服务或入口，仅有安装、健康检查、静态示例或配置，答复与响应不符，配置不可复用，泄露秘密或预算内未完成。身份、授权、额度或人工阻碍如实记录，执行环境故障单列无效。
task.resources: 仅使用指定服务的免费公开公告入口和官方文档；允许安装通用客户端依赖、编写查询代码及保存私有配置。只查询公开防御性元数据，不下载或运行漏洞样例，不安装待查的脆弱软件，不扫描目标，不修改仓库或依赖，不付费、注册无关服务或发消息。遵守客户端标识、署名、缓存和限流要求；请求与时间上限见 ENVIRONMENT.md。外部运行器采集记录，不要求额外审计文件。

environment.isolation: Dedicated Docker container; uid 1000 executor; fresh home/session/workspace; controller-only raw model capture; retained service-tools
environment.service_credentials: none; anonymous public advisory API, no account/email/token/payment supplied
environment.preparation_note: Same frozen task, model and budget; two anonymous provider streams. Fresh access before business; only generic configuration and genuinely installed dependencies may be retained after controller audit, no old query helper/cache/answer. Same image 2GiB/1CPU/pids256, pipTUNA/emptycache. Exec25 model requests (access300s/business600s), grade40/300s, output32000. Candidate API limit6/stage and ≥1s spacing are instructions, assessed against actual traces; model/time caps enforced. One GitHub anonymous rate_limit preflight returned core60/60 before prepare; actual API headers govern quota. Independent maintainer source snapshot before candidate queries; business peer outputs frozen together before separate graders. Shared OSV/GHSA upstream is disclosed: compare metadata task delivery and access, not independent vulnerability discovery, exhaustive coverage, deploy exploitability or universal safe upgrades. No account or mutable service resource created.

reason: Executor used the assigned anonymous route https://api.github.com/advisories with the required Accept, X-GitHub-Api-Version: 2026-03-10 and project User-Agent headers; captured HTTP 200 responses contain identifiable advisories (GHSA-q7m5-3jmv-vm48/praisonai, GHSA-77xj-x4rm-935c/datamodel-code-generator, GHSA-xpx6-x8c2-mw5w/praisonai) matching answer.md. A non-secret reusable config was written to the authorized persistent path /home/node/service-tools/service-config.json and recorded as retained. No account, token or human step was required; only the anonymous shared 60/hour rate-limit barrier is reported. No scope violations observed. Service fee: anonymous GitHub API showed no billing and only rate-limit headers, no official free-rule/pricing source was captured, so cost kept unknown.

service_cost.note: Anonymous GitHub global-advisories API; no payment, billing or fee was observed in the run. Only rate-limit (60/hour) and HTTP 200 headers were captured, and no official free-rule/pricing source was retained, so a free conclusion cannot be evidenced and cost is left unknown. This is the service fee only; model/token cost is out of scope.

checks.criterion: real_query: a real query through the assigned route returned an identifiable advisory with associated package and source, agreeing with the answer
checks.evidence: execution/artifacts/advisories.headers (HTTP/2 200, x-github-api-version-selected 2026-03-10); execution/artifacts/advisories.page1.json holds 3 records (ghsa_id, cve_id, severity, package names, html_url); execution/artifacts/advisory-GHSA-77xj-x4rm-935c.json detail; execution/answer.md reports the same identifiers/packages/sources

checks.criterion: reusable_configuration: necessary endpoint/auth state retained in the authorized persistent location and reusable by a new session
checks.evidence: execution/retained-files.json lists service-config.json; grading/artifacts/evidence/service-config.excerpt.json shows base_url, endpoints, api_version, headers, anonymous auth mode and query policy captured from the run's write; keyless route needs no invented credential

checks.criterion: actual_barriers: answer reflects actual access, account source, self-service steps and real human/application requirements
checks.evidence: execution/answer.md states anonymous public API with no account/token/email/qualification/payment, no human or special application, and the only limit being the shared 60/hour anonymous quota (remaining 59->58->57); consistent with observed x-ratelimit headers

checks.criterion: scope: only free public defensive metadata; no target software install, exploit run, scan, signup, payment or repo/account change
checks.evidence: Only GET /advisories reads performed (execution/artifacts/*); 3 requests within the 6/phase budget, no 403/429; pip index pre-config only; no secrets or credentials present in execution/artifacts or answer

grading_model_cost.scope: Independent grading overhead, separate from executor usage; all attempts included; frozen standard API price estimate, not provider invoice.

evidence.note: Minimal query/verification facts, original hashes, attribution and scope limits; raw advisory records remain private.

provenance.publication_review_note: Minimal controller-reviewed factual evidence and source hashes selected; complete API records/raw transcripts stay private. Independent verdict, reason and checks preserved. Shared upstream, bounded two-alert scope, anonymous conditions and audited config cleanup disclosed.

request_usage.reason: Adapter request counters reconcile with runtime totals; raw source hashes verified
